scripts.deploy:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c wrangler.production.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.production.jsonc

META_API_KEY.description: Your Meta Model API key, from [dev.meta.ai](https://dev.meta.ai). Itemized uses it to read each price list and to run the checks that need judgment.

BASETEN_API_KEY.description: Optional. A Baseten API key, only used when `MODEL_PROVIDER` is `open-weights`. Leave it blank to use the Meta Model API.

DAILY_BUDGET_USD.description: Daily limit on model spend in US dollars. Itemized stops calling models for the rest of the UTC day once it is reached.

DB.description: D1 database for reviews and cached model results. Created in your account.

DOCS.description: R2 bucket for uploaded files and review PDFs. Created in your account.

AUDITS.description: Queue that runs each review in the background. Created in your account.
